dimensionsMm.assignmentBasis: ASUS prints a two-figure board outline in inches and centimetres next to the 'ATX Form Factor' label; the centimetre figures are recorded here in millimetres as the board's two in-plane dimensions, matching the convention already used for motherboard.gigabyte-b650-aorus-elite-ax-v2. thicknessMm is absent because the page publishes no board thickness; it is not filled from the ATX form factor, which standardises mounting geometry rather than this SKU's physical dimensions.

notes: Published facts with no cat6 or compat2 field, kept verbatim rather than dropped; all from source.cat6.asus.tuf-gaming-b650-plus-wifi.techspec. Socket: 'AMD Socket AM5 for AMD Ryzen(TM) 9000 & 8000 & 7000 Series Desktop Processors'. Chipset: 'AMD B650'. Memory: '4 x DIMM, Max. 256GB, DDR5', dual channel, ECC and Non-ECC un-buffered memory, AMD EXPO supported. Memory speed list, verbatim: '7600+(OC)/ 7200(OC)/ 7000(OC)/ 6800(OC)/6600(OC)/ 6400(OC)/ 6200(OC)/ 6000(OC)/ 5800(OC)/ 5600(OC)/ 5400(OC)/ 5200/ 5000/ 4800'. maxMemorySpeedMtS is absent: ASUS publishes the leading rate as '7600+(OC)', where the trailing '+' states a floor for the overclocking ceiling rather than an exact maximum — the same reading already applied to motherboard.asus-tuf-gaming-b860m-plus-wifi's '8800+MT/s' figure, so recording any numeric ceiling would invent one (C1, C14). checkRamSupport reports unavailable for this board as a result, which is the true statement; socket, chipset and form factor are unaffected. BIOS: biosMinVersionForCpu is deliberately empty under O6.
